Kept as a narrower entry: s.2: "A public supplier shall pay an environmental levy to the Comptroller at the rate of 7% of the total income from the sale of electricity supplied to consumers." Not a carbon price, no emissions basis. Only this edition is served; later amendments, if any, are not shown.

Section 6(1): "Any act or practice in the course of industrial or commercial activities that misleads, or is likely to mislead, the public with respect to an enterprise or its activities, in particular, the products or services offered by such enterprise, shall constitute an act of unfair competition." General rule; no environmental claim is named. No Anguilla consumer protection or advertising Act appears in the Revised Statutes index.
